claim_boundary: The audit proves the inspected local machine and required Lilies ledgers had no detected automatic consumer at the observation time. It does not prove that an unrelated external machine, provider account user, container, or unclassified process cannot use the same credential. Historical aggregate token totals come from persisted usage, but 312 model attempts lack per-attempt usage receipts: they are reported as unknown, never as confirmed zero-token calls. New Local Lilies checkpoints persist usage-backed call counts for exact future reconciliation.
